AVERI Pilot Report: The World's First Double-Blind Evaluation of a Proprietary Language Model

https://www.averi.org/ourwork/averi-pilot-report-the-worlds-first-double-blind-eval

Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite in secure enclave with DeepMind, OpenMined, MLCommons; notes EU CoP and Illinois SB 315 requirements. Cited from a search snippet; not re-fetched in full.

Signals citing this source

  • AVERI, A (for): Secure-enclave double-blind protocol with DeepMind, OpenMined and MLCommons; neither party sees the other's confidential material.
  • AVERI, M (for): Publishes pilot reports and open tooling; framework paper with AI Assurance Levels.
  • AVERI, S (against): Pilot audits are voluntary and lab-selected; not yet a full-time auditor.
  • AVERI, R (for): Publishes pilot findings.
  • MLCommons (AILuminate), M (for): Open benchmark specification and methodology.
  • MLCommons (AILuminate), A (for): Used as neutral ground in the AVERI double-blind pilot.
